description: Any map from a finite type A to a finite type B with more elements in A than in B sends two distinct inputs to the same output.
signature:
Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (f : α → β)
  (h : Fintype.card β < Fintype.card α) : ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y
